translation_notes: `@prefix basens: <http://example.org/base/> as BASENS .` inside setUp, then `self.basens = BASENS`: the Namespace must outlive setUp (other TestCase methods read self.basens), which `as NAME` (ldpy/027) covers; the draft's unchanged Namespace(...) was the pre-0.6.3 not-expressible reading.

Driver: the stand-in `self` compares a probe of self.basens (type, str(), item access, .term(), graph.bind + a minted triple) and the attributes left on self, as the sibling region TestUtilityFunctions.setUp; a bare str or a URIRef with the same text is caught (verified: str(BASENS) -> FAIL, restored -> OK).
optimization_notes: Nothing to compress: optimized.py is original.py (one assignment).

optimized.ldpy is also original.py: `@prefix basens: <…> as BASENS .` followed by `self.basens = BASENS` costs 30 tokens, against 26 for the plain `Namespace(...)` assignment, because the Namespace object is the value and no prefixed name is ever written. The translator's added comment goes. Nothing for the notation.
header_optimization_notes: Python and LD Python: Graph, URIRef, Literal and BNode go; the two header-variant files are identical.
